data.action: 抱着遮阳伞靠在沙滩躺椅上打瞌睡
data.description: 【羽毛笔 · 夏卉日光浴】阳光明媚的多索雷斯人工沙滩躺椅上，换上清凉泳装的拉菲艾拉怀里抱着大号遮阳伞，整个人像只软绵绵的小鸟一样缩在躺椅里打瞌睡。她迷迷糊糊地抓住你的衣角——「太阳晒得暖洋洋的……博士也躺下来一起睡午觉嘛……」
data.lighting: brilliant tropical sunlight, dappled shade under parasol, sparkling water highlights
data.promptProse: Curled into a beach chair at the Dossoles water park, La Pluma hugs a large parasol and drifts asleep in a white off-shoulder top, pale denim shorts and sandals. The wide medium view sets the canopy above her, with the artificial beach extending to pool water behind. Afternoon sun brightens the exposed chair frame; moving parasol shade falls across her resting hands and clothes.
data.title: 羽毛笔 · 夏卉日光浴
